newsitem.title: USA: Walden Residential says buys TX properties.
newsitem.headline: Walden Residential says buys TX properties.

text.p: Walden Residential Properties Inc said Tuesday it bought six apartment properties, comprising 1,263 units, in Dallas/Fort Worth and Austin, Texas.
The company said the purchase price for all six properties was about $39.8 million, including closing costs.
The company said it plans to spend about $3 million on property renovations.

The company said that in connection with the deal, it issued $1.1 million of operating partnership interests in an existing subsidiary partnership, which are convertible into 44,419 shares of common stock.
The company said it borrowed $18.5 million under its unsecured credit facility and funded the remaining $20.6 million from working capital.
